title: Daniel in the Lions' Den Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Daniel in the Lions’ Den Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Daniel in the Lions' Den Bible crossword: King Darius, the sealed stone, the shut mouths of the lions. KJV-rooted clues, free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: A decree that no man may pray, a window that stays open toward Jerusalem anyway, and a den sealed with a stone and the king's own signet — Daniel 6 is a story about quiet, unshowy courage, and it makes a satisfying grid. Every clue in Daniel in the Lions' Den comes from the chapter: the presidents and princes who set the trap, the king who could not sleep, the angel who shut the lions' mouths.
It's one of the gentler puzzles in the archive, which makes it a good place to start if Bible crosswords are new to you. The closing verse is Daniel's own answer, called up out of the den at dawn.

clues.text: King who signed the decree and then regretted it
Laid on the mouth of the den and sealed
City Daniel opened his window toward

verseText: My God hath sent his angel, and hath shut the lions mouths, that they have not hurt me: forasmuch as before him innocency was found in me; and also before thee, O king, have I done no hurt.
